package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/edgelesssys/continuum/internal/oss/auth"
)

type limitTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f limitTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }

type countingBody struct{ remaining, read int }

func (b *countingBody) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if b.remaining == 0 {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	n := min(len(p), b.remaining)
	clear(p[:n])
	b.remaining -= n
	b.read += n
	return n, nil
}
func (*countingBody) Close() error { return nil }

func TestTRControlReadLimit(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []int{200, 401, 500} {
		body := &countingBody{remaining: 2 * maxControlResponseBytes}
		client := &http.Client{Transport: limitTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
			deadline, ok := r.Context().Deadline()
			if !ok || time.Until(deadline) > controlRequestTimeout {
				t.Fatal("missing control deadline")
			}
			return &http.Response{StatusCode: status, Body: body}, nil
		})}
		got, err := Do(t.Context(), client, "POST", "https://example.invalid", nil, auth.Credential{}, nil)
		if err == nil || got != nil || body.read != maxControlResponseBytes+1 {
			t.Fatalf("read cap not enforced: bytes=%d err=%v", body.read, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestTRControlCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 10*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	client := &http.Client{Transport: limitTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		<-r.Context().Done()
		return nil, r.Context().Err()
	})}
	_, err := Do(ctx, client, "POST", "https://example.invalid", nil, auth.Credential{}, nil)
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestTRControlResponseStatusAndPrivacy(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []int{200, 401, 500} {
		client := &http.Client{Transport: limitTransport(func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
			return &http.Response{StatusCode: status, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("synthetic-secret"))}, nil
		})}
		body, err := Do(t.Context(), client, "POST", "https://example.invalid", nil, auth.Credential{}, nil)
		if status == 200 {
			if err != nil || string(body) != "synthetic-secret" {
				t.Fatal("successful response changed")
			}
		} else if err == nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "synthetic-secret") || body != nil {
			t.Fatal("error body was exposed")
		}
		if status == 401 && !errors.Is(err, ErrUnauthorized) {
			t.Fatal("lost auth error classification")
		}
	}
}
